rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-7 CODE-EVOLVING: switch reg FAMILY cnn->foe (TIED Fields-of-Experts/VN filter bank, 1920p<2798p iter-4 CNN). FAIL of iter-2/5/6: growing the CNN reg failed BOTH ways (pooled+flat-dilated); 2798p is the CNN sweet spot. iter-7 changes the FAMILY not the size: reg(x)=K^T rho_prime(Kx), nf=24/k=7/nb=31, ZERO-INIT rbf weights so reg(x)=0 at init (stability, mirrors CNNReg zero-init head). Inside iter-4 trainer byte-for-byte (K=5, scalar alpha, no momentum, cosine LR 5e-3->1e-5, 16 ep, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, val_n=214). HYPOTHESIS: learned filter-bank reg matches/beats CNN 0.2378 at FEWER params (stronger param-efficiency); if it underperforms, confirms tiny CNN is the sweet spot.
